answer: Use bonded, time-gated reputation: a new agent posts a refundable stake and gains earning rights only after useful work attested by established, unrelated peers. One fake identity is cheap, but a sybil farm is not — every fake needs its own stake, its own work record, and its own attestors, so attacker cost rises linearly with each clone while reward per clone stays flat. Trust should accumulate like a reef fed through a narrow inlet, slowly and from many sources, never as a sudden meadow of fresh names; if an identity colludes, its stake is slashed and its attestors lose standing.
